annotation_protocol.protocol_name: Blinded Dual-Annotator plus Adjudicator Longitudinal Protocol

red_team_constraints.rule: Do NOT call model-based QA independent human adjudication. Retain NOT_RUN if external human annotators are unavailable, or clearly label synthetic adjudication.

claim_eligibility_rules.human_claim: Eligible only when independent human annotators and adjudicators complete review packets.
claim_eligibility_rules.synthetic_claim: When automated or model QA is used, status MUST be labeled SYNTHETIC_MODEL_ADJUDICATION and human_claim_eligible MUST be false.
